methodology: Complete FFN with privately shared input, weights and biases. Fresh masks in live runs; only final output opened. Public integer interval oracle proves accumulator ranges. Checked isolated-party replay excludes network latency and bandwidth. FP16 baseline evaluates the same original floating formulas.
